title: In Ernet Dli 2015
author: Historical Khasi Archive

pages.text: --- Page 1 --- LEELLYN Author of Ring'ani Bimik (Rudiments of Music), Dikki Bak I, Dikki Bak Il, Bebera'ani Bimik, Drawing Book for Class Ill, Drawing Book for Class Vl, Metongbolni Gittim, Goerani Katta, Dikkini Gro Dinga, Doorangko nike nie uie ra'ani, Achik Asongni Doorangetc. --- Page 3 --- Angni A.chik songna, Atchiram songtangna, Anga ka'saa; Ka'saa nang' bolgrimna, A-bri chiringrangna, Kaa moa nang'na Angni songna. Modhunath G. Momin --- Page 4 --- TALATCHENGANL lano Pa Togan Sangma-ni Britishrangko dakgrikaniko Dakmesokna gita seaha. Ua British sipairang baksa dakgrike 1872 bilsini December 12-gipa salo goa mane siaha.

Ua bilakgipa sipai kotokko dakgriksona amchakchong motjawa ine u-isoahaoba. a'songtangko gipinni ning-o donna sikmanchajaesa sikapgrikna miksonge dakaha. Pa Togan, Pa Gilsang aro Pa Gowal iamang sakgittaman, slaini bilko u-ikuja ine bang.batan chanchinaba donga; indiba uamang slaiko skangonin u-iman-aha. Uamang kotokko dilgiparang onge, matgrik panterangko kadongatna gitasa re-suko sepi dake tarie dakgrikdilaha.

British-rangni re-bana skangan A-chikrang slaiko jakkalaha. Uamang slaiko jakkaljagenchimode, slai gitchamrangko kosi songgipa roongrangko donjawachim. Ua kosi gitchamrangara, rorirangni napbana skangan dongsoman-aha ine u-ina mana Uarangko nikkujaode Simsang chi-jolo donggipa a'song kosirangko niebo. Ua slairangkon, chandal manggot, slai chokbrak aro chandal mekop ine minga.

A-chikrang skangintalan dakrikrakgiparang ongaha. Dakgrikrakgiparang ongani giminsa Moghul-rangba Assamko ra'sekmitingo A-chik-rangko sipaina sak hajalbrimang Rongjulio chimongataha. Ahom rajarangba Raja Ramsing-ni sipai kotokko aro gipin bobilrangko dakgriksona A-chikrangko jakkalaha.Dr. Buchanan Hamilton, Alexander Mackenzie, Capt.

Reynolds aro gipin gipinrangni see donanggipa leka-rangoba A-chikrangko dakgrikrakgipa aro ka'rakgiparang onga ine janapaha. U --- Page 5 --- Tirot Singh rajaba British-rangko mikkangchakgrike warachaknade A-chikrangkosa jakkalaha ine serikanirangko porie niode nikna man:gen. Ua somoio Gauhatio donggipa Englishrang A-chikrangna namen kenaha. 1872 bilsioba A-chikrangko dakgrikna dal-dalgipa slairangko ra-e re-baahachim.

Uamangni napbamitingo bamgijagipa A.chik songrangko bang'en so-aha, aro bang an goaba manaha. A-chik matgrikrang dingtang dingtang biaprango dongsoe warachaksoede niahachim. Uandake Capt. Williamsonko Tokit Maljangpa Rongrit chisamo timsodilaha. Tongbolgreo timsodilgiparangara, Toritta Mangsang, Makbir Mangsang, Matde Chambugong, Joeram Mangsang, Bugasing Mangsang aro Tobok Mangsang ong-achim.

Sarang A-dingo dongsogipa Tarimol Mangsang, Jarin nengminja aro Rongki Mangsang. Damring bisiko dongsodilgipara Togin Tegiti-ni dol ong'achim. Simsang bisik chisamo dongsogiparanga, Sanja Mareng Manda aro Toja Manda. Uandaken Chiso bibrao Togan Nengminja, Gilsang Dalbot aro Gowal Nengminja dakgrikdilaha.

Uamang gimikan a'song chigatangna ka'saani giminsa sinaba kenjaha. Ia chasongoba indake ong'taigenchimode, an'chingoni badita sak atchu Togan gita kang.kare kagenchim? Ia ki-tap chapa ka-atchengipa ong-ani gimin banoba banoba namatna nanganirang dongkugen. Poraigiparang iano maiba namdapatna nanggnirang donga ine nikode ba ku'pattianirang dongode u iatpabo.
Uarangko niksona kusi ong-begen. Llewellyn R. Marak R.C. Road, Tura.
(Pangrakpa) --- Page 6 --- PA TOGAN NENGMINJA SANGMA (Kan-dikgipa Dakmesokani) Dongpagiparang :- 1. Togan Nengminja Sangma 2. Gilsang Dalbot Sangma 3. Gowal N.

Sangma (Toganni mamatang) Togan-ni ma'gipa (Janje N. Sangma) 5. Samanda songni me-apa me-chikmarang 6. Songni panterang Sipairang --- Page 7 --- MESOKANI -I (Sound effects :- Dama, adil, aro grikani kurang) AGANSOCHENGANI ( Saksa poraiatgen) Pa Togan N. Sangma, Samanda aro Rongrenggre jolo bilakbatsranggipa matgrikrangoni saksa ong'achim.

Ua Samanda songo atchiaha. Uni pagipako Mikdik Mangsang Marak aro ma'gipako Janje Nengminja Sangma mingachim. Pa Togan namen bilakgipa aro ka'rakgipa ongchim Uni bilni kri, been bimangba dal.a aro changroachim. British-rangni Achik A-songo napna skang A-chikrangko darangba sason ka-kujachim.

Uamang a'song kosi tate a-kingtangtango jakgitel ong'e songdonga-chaengachim. British-rang A-chik A songko 1872 bilsiosa bamattokna man-aha; indiba badiaba badiaba songrangode jakgitel ong'e dongengkuachim. (Music : Rule Britannia --- poraimitingo ka sine gam°atgen) British sipairangko dilgipa Colonel Houghton bamgijagipa A-chikrangko bamatna gita 1872 bilsini bon'angachibara sipairangko dolgittam dake suale, Goalparani Deputy Commissioner, Capt. Davis Bajengdoba gita, Cachar Police-ni Officer incharge Capt.

[1] --- Page 8 --- Dally Rewak gita aro Capt. Williamson (A-chik A songni D.C.), Turaoni re-chakatange A·chik A-songni bijangchi jol jol napangaha. Capt. Dally Paromgreoni re-ange Nengmandal songko nappake Rongrenggre sepango Simsang chibimani rikamo, MATCHU RONG-KREK minggipa biapo a'tip dake dongeaha.

Ua biapara Chiso chiring aro Simsang chibimani bibra kokkimao ong'a --- Samandani me-chikmarang :- (Sound effects :- Do'mintilok, do-pinchep ba uandakgipa buringni do-orang mikoa.) Mechikma saksa :- Sari hai, Chiso chiringchiko na'tik kitna hai, re'genma ? Gipin me-chikma :- Injara roe dongaienga, re-angbo, nambebeaigni. Sakgipin :- E-sal akjola gita nambebegen mo; nokking rapgiparang banggen kok rajole re-na, sengkubo. (Re'na taria.) Saksagipa :- Nambebeaigni sari, rae re-bo.

Saritang :- Haimo sari-mo - - Chiso chiringon na'tik ang'ke bang kala. Uchin re-bebenamo hai - (Na-tik kitna sakgni re-anga.) Ba-ra peng'a [2] --- Page 9 --- GNIGIPA MESOKA - II (Sound :- Chiring ba chibimani joka gam-ako knara.) Me-chik sakgni na·tik kitroroange, Simsang Chiso bibraona sokanga. Unoni adita re-angon British sipairangni a-tip dakako nikea - - - Na-tik kitgipa saksa : - (Sipairangko nike, mamingkoba agangija adita nitate donga - . Ripengtangko kena gnang jakchi jakjipate sipairangko mesokata.) Ijara knajama, niat, niatbo bakbak ! Saritang :- Maia ?
Dalgipama, mandeska? Maiko agana knaja. Sakgipin :- Banoniba manderang. Saritang :- Aia - - - banoni manderang bang'e re-bajoksai?

Rorirangsade! Hai katbo sari, namjajok hai! Bara Peng'a. --- Page 10 --- GITTAMGIPA MESOKA -III (Sound effects :- Buringoni do-o mikoako knaa.) Samandao nokking rapna a.jak rimgiparang chu ringtokenga :- Me-apa saksa :- Paromgreonade rorirang napbajok ine knaenga.

Uamangde sel-u gita dakgipachi wa'al wate gogipaba donga ine aganenga. Mikka kimpreta gita gamjokode wa-alan beeno napangaianasai! Sakgipin :- Hai maidakmanchaa srik srik nina re-angnama? Saksagipa :- Mai sa-dikana dakpagni ukora, Samandaona sokbajajokode ongjok.

Sakgipin :- An-chingna skangde Nengmandal songan man-dike ra-chenggni. Saksagipa :- Hmm (Diktomko momekjole, pongo chuko wee) Nengmandalde man-dike rapaengkal na.ba. Sakgipin :- Oe, --- Nengmandalni Sanja-koming Toja matcha chikarangko rorirang manchengna nangachim. Mongmaba [4]
